parsing.query: Any query component including empty ? is 400 before admission. Unknown, duplicate or percent-encoded query names are not parsed, all refused. No pagination/limits query.
parsing.headerAdmission: Exactly one Host matching canonical configured authority. Duplicate/non-UTF8 participating headers fail. Missing OS-observed peer is 403. Unix requires separately admitted same UID; TCP rate peer canonicalizes mapped IPv4 and IPv6 /64. parsing.content: Mutations require exactly one application/json content-type (case-insensitive), optionally semicolon-separated charset=utf-8 only; any content-encoding is 415. parsing.body: Mutation body cap 8192 bytes, 2s timeout; read error/over-limit ->413; timeout ->408; malformed JSON/type/unknown/duplicate struct field/trailing value ->400. UTF-8 password/code cap4096 after JSON parsing; input strings are not trimmed. Strict bool false only, optional defaults false; true ->400; null/number/string ->400. Sign-out map accepts duplicate keys while parsing but any surviving key ->400; zero bytes becomes {}, whitespace-only is invalid.
parsing.concurrency: Four shared nonwaiting worker semaphore permits; exhausted ->503 request_refused. Blocking task retains permit even if caller disconnects. HTTP cancellation is not rollback.
parsing.email: ASCII <=4096 bytes, no ASCII controls or whitespace trimming; local nonempty, not dot-prefixed, no consecutive dots, only alnum/_/apostrophe/+/minus/dot, last not apostrophe/dot; domain labels begin alnum and contain alnum/minus, final TLD >=2 ASCII letters.
